prompt: Our state agency client says Section 508 requires them to meet WCAG 2.1 AA by 2027. Is that right?
assertions: Identifies the conflation: Section 508 applies to federal agencies and incorporates WCAG 2.0 AA via the 2017 standards
States state and local governments are covered by the DOJ ADA Title II web rule, which uses WCAG 2.1 AA
Notes DOJ extended the Title II compliance dates by one year in spring 2026 (91 FR 20902)
Notes HHS similarly extended its Section 504 web rule compliance dates (91 FR 25496)
Avoids asserting exact new per-entity deadlines and advises checking the extension rules directly
